title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
summary: Strata is an open-source project that enables running the Qwen 3.8 Flash Next 125B parameter language model on consumer-grade RTX 4090 GPUs at 100 tokens/second, making large language model inference accessible without expensive data center hardware.
problem_solved: Makes running 125B parameter large language models feasible on consumer hardware at ~$1,600 instead of requiring $20,000+ server GPUs.
why_valuable: Democratizes access to state-of-the-art AI capabilities by enabling high-speed local LLM inference on affordable consumer GPUs, benefiting developers, researchers, and AI enthusiasts.
